pages.text: Organic matter → matching mob cell. Each mob has its own analyzer recipe.

Default storage: 20,000 energy.$(br)Base use: 20 energy/tick.$(br)Base timer: 400 ticks (20 seconds).$(br)Maximum overclockers: 10.$(br2)The completion tick also consumes energy, preserving the original machine timing. Progress resets if processing cannot continue.
